decisions.summary: Read-only uncached trackOptions accessor on store.getters and typed TrackOption; [] unless ready/conference/selection, then public core sortTracksByName mapped to fresh {name,checked}; existing setSelectedTracks reused. Every NS03/NS04 export and behavior retained.

Pure immutable toggleTrack, setAllTracks and checkedTrackNames helpers. applyFilterResult commits existing setSelectedTracks only for arrays, including []; every nonarray is ignored. Done replaces the complete applied filter; other selection fields and loader count retained.

Fullscreen native modal: Frame/Page, Filter Sessions ActionBar, close NavigationButton calls $closeModal() with no data; local draft initialized once from trackOptions. Reopen recreates draft from applied state; Android Back also discards through undefined closeCallback.

Tracks heading, ten sorted native Switch rows, automationText track-<name>. checkedChange ignores programmatic synchronization. Reset and Deselect All clear only draft; Select All checks all; Done returns checked names in displayed order. No separate Cancel beyond ActionBar close; no track icons.

Filter sessions button beside SegmentedBar, disabled until ready; fullscreen $showModal closeCallback calls only applyFilterResult. Existing search focus, states/messages and NS04 rows/dialogs unchanged; no reload or search/mode/favorite reset.

Real loader/core Vitest for fresh derived options, immutable helpers, apply/discard/preservation, all five reference cases. All 69 NS04 tests retained; 6 files/94 tests twice, +6 getter/+19 draft-result tests. Modal rendering, Switch taps and native dismissal are device-only evidence, not Vitest.

Historical A debug build and bundle, B install -r with matching installed hash; B1–B7 and bounded same-PID logcat PASS, exactly one XML-confirmed Back. Coordinator pixels PASS for all 27 distinct frames. Phase C performs static gates and host hashing only; no rebuild/device action.

Phase A passed in a single run with capture-before-write ordering. Phase B passed in a single run on the already-running RN01_API36 emulator, started by the coordinator during NS04; no settings changes.
During B the helper rejected an ambiguous text match because Select All is a substring of Deselect All, then switched to exact matching before tapping; tooling correction, not a product failure.
decisions.disposition: DISCLOSED; NO INCORRECT TAP OR PRODUCT FIX

decisions.summary: Exactly one Android Back keyevent 4 at B6, preceded by fresh XML proving the filter modal open, as D7 allows. Coordinator confirmed the count from commands.jsonl; Phase C reparsed history without contacting a device.

Coordinator inspected all 27 distinct frames (28 PNGs): PASS; no keyboard or personal content. Switch states differ mainly by thumb position/track colour (NS07 accessibility); FAVORITE SESSIONS wraps beside Filter; Reset and Deselect All give the same draft (Android source parity).

trackOptions is a read-only accessor on store.getters rather than a cached Vuex getter, so every read returns a fresh array (D1). Switch checkedChange ignores programmatic updates so Select All/Reset cannot double-toggle. Modal close NavigationButton and Android Back both reach closeCallback without data, which applyFilterResult ignores.
